verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison documents a platform API and Python client (API keys, create_task, JobNames enum), so this axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
